About.label: (04) About
About.bio: I started out as a mechanical engineer and became a full stack developer because I love building useful things. That path taught me to listen, understand the need, ask the right questions, then deliver a clean product. Based in Paris, my goal comes down to choosing the right tools, testing, and shipping a product where I own every detail.
